title: Zipper
content: The zippers that come with CLO3D always seem a bit underwhelming, and their size often appears too small to me. When used on the clothes, they can undermine the overall quality of the garments. That's why I've specifically crafted #5 - sized zippers. There are two types, and each type has two closure methods. All the attributes and adjustment methods of these zippers are fully compatible with the software. I typically apply them to the making of down jackets and padded jackets, which endows the clothing with an overall sense of luxury. I've set up UV grid layouts for both the zippers and their pulls, enabling the customization of LOGOs, just as shown in my illustrations. The UV grids are directly incorporated into the normal map of each zipper file, and the file format is.PSD. After downloading, you can click to make modifications. I'm still in the process of continuous exploration, hoping to offer more convenient methods to enthusiasts!![2430ead84cb140e68e6af7a5a9630abd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/15c014faef94469c93dde357b5fc4cb2/images/2430ead84cb140e68e6af7a5a9630abd%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E7%89%88.png)
content_description: This page offers customizable #5-sized zipper assets designed for CLO3D to enhance garment quality and luxury, complete with editable UV grid layouts for personalized logos.

title: leather materials ,  physical
content:
## ![f70b637dafc64ebbb5a64d47be0cd3c9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/3c8d8179fadc44a6a664fc910abec18e/images/f70b637dafc64ebbb5a64d47be0cd3c9Shell%20Cordovan%20Leather%202.png)I’ve been focusing a lot on **leather materials in Marvelous Designer** , not just visually but also on **physical behavior** , especially **edge stiffness, thickness, and how the back side of leather reacts in folds and tension**.

I’m curious — are there sellers or creators who really care about these details, or is most leather content still treated more like stiff fabric presets?

Would love to hear different approaches.

* * *
content_description: This page explores the detailed physical properties of leather materials in Marvelous Designer, inviting discussion on realistic leather behavior versus standard fabric presets among creators and sellers.

title: Simulation causes Alembic Avatar to Reset
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7/images/9cea28cde3e24a6d8c30c8a61f948e97Issue.png)

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BmwsMDTddiM?start=0

Hey guys, does anybody know how to fix this issue?  
  
I used to be able to import an Alembic Avatar, reposition and rotate it, run the simulation, which would drape the clothes over the Alembic Avatar, and then play the Alembic Avatar animation so the cloth would follow and react to the animation.   
Now when I start the start the simulation, the Alembic Avatar resets to its default position it's in upon first importing it into the scene, causing the cloth to distort.   
Simulation Settings are Normal (Default), using GPU(same happens with CPU though) and Particle Distance of all cloth is set to 20mm.  
Latest graphics drivers and Marvelous Designer versions are installed.   
Any help would be much appreciated!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Please share your project file with us through our 'Contact Us' page.🙏🏻https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7 will be the best way to see what is going on there.
content_description: A community forum page for troubleshooting Alembic Avatar simulation issues in Marvelous Designer to help users resolve cloth animation and positioning problems.
